description: STEP 2 of the screen-recording flow. Uploads a local video and submits it for review (PUTs the file to storage, then submits). The recording MUST show the challenge code, so run vibevo_start_social_account_stats_session FIRST, give the user the code, and only call this once they have recorded the screen with it. Refused with SOCIAL_CONNECT_ACTIVE when the account already gets statistics from a live platform connection: disconnect it first or just leave it be. Requires the write scope + PUBLIC_API_WRITE.

durationSeconds.description: Length of the recording, if known.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the local video file (mp4, mov, webm or avi).

name: vibevo_upload_social_account_stats
title: Upload a screen recording of the account statistics (creator)
